title: 8、泉床立夏

content_zh:
“对了，还要买奖励品来着，不过，那个家伙居然这么坑我，怎么可能给她买巧克力，正好，就这个吧，看起来也差不多了。”
泉镜花说着来到了路边的小店里，买了一包辣条。
回到家中，镜花的母亲安梦溪小姐此时果然正在电脑之前，正在疯**作着自己的游戏角色。看她的手速简直就是大神级别的玩家，堪称手速惊人，仿佛抽搐一般。
不过，镜花知道那只不过是没什么卵用的瞎操作，果然，不过片刻，安小姐的电脑屏幕就已经变成了黑白。
看着安小姐躺在基地等重生，镜花将辣条丢了过去。
“任务奖励！”
“喵呜！pocky！”安梦溪抓住了辣条，正大喜的时候，她忽然惊讶的问道：“奇怪，这不是pocky啊！怎么会是这个，我的pocky呢！”
“不不不，这就是pocky。”
泉镜花坚定的说道。
“pocky是巧克力棒。这个不是pocky，这个是辣条！”
安梦溪反驳道，虽然这样说着，她还是撕开了包装，拿起辣条塞进了嘴中。
“果然味道不对，这不是pocky的味道。”
泉镜花连忙说道：“不，就是pocky，这是变异的巧克力棒，所以样子和味道都跟普通的巧克力棒不同。”
“变异的？”安梦溪的脸上顿时浮现出喜色，但随即她的脸色就变得难看：“好辣。”
泉镜花立刻解释道：“虽然味道不一样，但是它最根本的地方却没有改变，还是可以像pocky一样，一人咬着一头，慢慢吃进去。”
泉镜花所说的是pocky最著名的一种吃法，一对情侣一人咬着巧克力棒的一头，然后慢慢的朝着中间吃过去，最终两个人将整个巧克力棒吃光的时候，也就到了亲密接触的时候。
“是吗？要习习吗？”
安梦溪扭头咬着辣条，咬字不清的说着。泉镜花好不容易才听明白她说的是要试试吗。
猫耳女仆装，又摆出如此亲密的样子。镜花顿时感觉到心中荡漾，不禁有些后悔，早知道就不为了报复她而换成辣条了。终于有和猫耳女仆妹子玩亲密游戏的时候，竟然不是巧克力棒而是辣条，这格调也太low了点。
但是，尽管如此，她的内心里还是动荡着，仿佛有一个声音在劝着她凑上去。

虽然泉镜花承认这是因为自己定力不足的缘故，看到漂亮的女人就动心。但是，眼前的人也确实是少见的美人。单论容貌的话就是顶尖的美女，更何况她那独有的气质。
泉镜花虽然没有自己接触过什么美女，但也看到过不少猫耳女仆的cosplay，其中最大的问题往往不是容貌，而是有一种做作的感觉。
而偏偏眼前的人，即便是故作姿态，也显得十分自然。
如果还是前世的身体，那么现在小镜花就该立起来了。但是很遗憾的是这个世界里已经没有了那个事物的存在。
镜花只感觉到眼前的人似乎越来越有吸引力，她不禁鄙夷起自己来。
竟然对自己的母亲都有了感觉，真是禽兽不如啊。
的确是禽兽不如，现在的镜花纵然是心如禽兽也注定只能禽兽不如，根本没有犯罪工具也没有犯罪能力的她不仅做不了什么，反而，因为女子的身体会产生奇怪的反应。
不知不觉间，她的双眼变得迷离起来。
夏风瑶说她是容易被玩坏的身体，这并不是夸张。
连泉镜花自己都是如此觉得，孤僻并不是仅仅是性格问题，也是她的自我保护。幸好这是一个比较正常的世界，如果换成里番世界的话，泉镜花觉得自己一定是第一话就会被用强然后彻底沦落的类型。
现在她的眼神已经颇有些失神的感觉。一旦被女孩子迷到，她就会不由自主的呈现出这样的姿态。
一声清亮的脆响。
泉镜花用力的一记耳光抽在了自己身上。
“我才不要跟三十多岁的老女人玩亲密游戏呢！”
总算清醒过来的泉镜花冲入了自己的房间。
身后的母亲咬着辣条，困惑的摇晃着猫耳。
而泉镜花则是在房间里看着自己的笔记本。
她拿起了笔，却一点东西都写不下。
“我该如何是好呢？”
她的心中如此想着，却不愿意将这种情绪书写出来。

content_en:
"By the way, I still need to buy rewards, but that guy cheated on me so much. How could he buy her chocolates? Just right, this is it. It looks like it's about the same."
Quan Jinghua said that she came to a small shop on the roadside and bought a pack of spicy strips.
Back home, Jinghua's mother, Miss An Mengxi, was in front of the computer, frantically playing her game character. Judging from her hand speed, she is like a master-level player. Her hand speed is astonishing, as if she is twitching.
However, Jinghua knew that it was just a useless operation. Sure enough, within a moment, Miss An's computer screen had turned into black and white.
Seeing Miss An lying on the base waiting for rebirth, Jinghua threw the spicy strips over.
"Mission reward!"
"Meow! Pocky!" An Mengxi caught Latiao, and when she was overjoyed, she suddenly asked in surprise: "Strange, this is not a pocky! How could it be this, my pocky!"
"No, no, no, this is pocky."
Quan Jinghua said firmly.
"Pocky is a chocolate bar. This is not a pocky, this is a spicy bar!"
An Mengxi retorted. Even so, she tore open the package, picked up the spicy strips and stuffed them into her mouth.
"Sure enough, the taste is wrong. This is not the taste of pocky."
Izumi Kyoka said quickly: "No, it's pocky. This is a mutated chocolate bar, so it looks and tastes different from ordinary chocolate bars."
"Mutated?" An Mengxi's face suddenly showed joy, but then her expression turned ugly: "It's so spicy."
Izumi Kyoka immediately explained: "Although the taste is different, the most fundamental part of it has not changed. You can still bite one end and eat it slowly like pocky."
What Izumi Kyoka is talking about is the most famous way of eating pocky. A couple bites one end of the chocolate bar, and then slowly eats towards the middle. When the two people finally eat the entire chocolate bar, it is time for intimate contact.
"Really? Do you want to practice?"
An Mengxi turned her head and bit into the spicy strips, speaking indistinctly. Izumi Kyoka finally understood what she meant by trying it.
Cat-eared maid outfit, yet again in such an intimate manner. Jinghua suddenly felt her heart rippling, and she couldn't help but regret a little. If she had known better, she wouldn't have changed into spicy strips just to retaliate against her. Finally, when I played an intimate game with the cat-eared maid, it was not a chocolate bar but a spicy bar. This style was a bit too low.
But despite this, her heart was still turbulent, as if a voice was urging her to come forward.
Although Izumi Kyoka admitted that it was because of her lack of concentration that she was attracted to beautiful women when she saw them. However, the person in front of her is indeed a rare beauty. In terms of appearance alone, she is a top beauty, not to mention her unique temperament.
Although Izumi Kyoka has never come into contact with any beautiful women, she has seen many cosplays of cat-eared maids. The biggest problem among them is often not the appearance, but the artificial feeling.
But the person in front of me seemed very natural even if he was pretending.
If it was still the body of the previous life, then the little mirror flower should be erected now. But unfortunately, that thing no longer exists in this world.
Jinghua only felt that the person in front of her seemed to be more and more attractive, and she couldn't help but despise herself.
He actually has feelings for his own mother, he is really worse than a beast.
It is true that she is worse than an animal. Even if the current Kyoka has a heart like an animal, she is destined to be worse than an animal. She has no criminal tools and no ability to commit crimes. Not only can she not do anything, but the woman's body will produce strange reactions.
Unconsciously, her eyes became blurred.
Xia Fengyao said that she has a body that can be easily damaged., this is not an exaggeration.
Even Quan Jinghua herself feels this way. Being lonely is not just a personality problem, but also her self-protection. Fortunately, this is a relatively normal world. If it were a different world, Izumi Kyoka felt that she would be the type who would be raped and then completely degraded in the first episode.
Now her eyes were quite absent-minded. Once she is fascinated by a girl, she will involuntarily assume such a posture.
A clear crisp sound.
Quan Jinghua slapped herself hard.
"I don't want to play intimate games with an old woman in her thirties!"
Quan Jinghua, who finally woke up, rushed into her room.
The mother behind her bit her spicy sticks and shook her cat ears in confusion.
Izumi Kyoka was looking at her notebook in the room.
She picked up the pen, but couldn't write anything.
"What should I do?"
She was thinking so in her heart, but she was unwilling to write down this emotion.
